passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘These are My appointed feasts, the feasts of the LORD that you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a message.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD said, "These are My appointed feasts."
The LORD said, "These are the feasts of the LORD."
The LORD said, "You must proclaim these feasts as sacred assemblies."
The LORD said, "These are My appointed times."
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מוֹעֲדָֽי׃

passages.text: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, a day of sacred assembly. You must not do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
You may do work for six days.
The seventh day is different.
The seventh day is a Sabbath.
The Sabbath is a day of complete rest.
The Sabbath is a sacred assembly.
You must not do any work on the Sabbath.
This rule applies wherever you live.
The Sabbath belongs to the LORD.
passages.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ מִקְרָא־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ שַׁבָּ֥ת הִוא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל מֽוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave special feasts to His people.
These feasts belong to the LORD.
These feasts are sacred assemblies.
You must announce these assemblies at their set times.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִקְרָאֵ֖י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם בְּמוֹעֲדָֽם׃

passages.text: The Passover to the LORD begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.
passages.sermon:
The LORD commands the Passover.
The Passover is a special observance for the LORD.
The Passover begins at twilight.
The Passover starts on the fourteenth day.
The fourteenth day is in the first month.
passages.original: בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: On the fifteenth day of the same month begins the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the LORD. For seven days you must eat unleavened bread.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave the Israelites special times to celebrate.
These times are called appointed feasts.
The Feast of Unleavened Bread is one of these feasts.
This feast begins on the fifteenth day of the first month.
The feast is for the LORD.
The Feast of Unleavened Bread lasts seven days.
During these seven days, you must eat bread without yeast.
passages.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֔ה חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים מַצּ֥וֹת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

passages.text: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly; you are not to do any regular work.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
The Israelites must gather on the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
They must hold a sacred assembly on this day.
They must not do any regular work on this day.
passages.original: בַּיּוֹם֙ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן מִקְרָא־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: For seven days you are to present an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the seventh day there shall be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God told them about the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
For seven days, you must bring an offering made by fire to the LORD.
On the seventh day, you must gather for a sacred assembly.
You must not do any regular work on that day.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֛ה לַיהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ מִקְרָא־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘When you enter the land that I am giving you and you reap its harvest, you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a message for the Israelites.
The LORD said, “You will enter the land I am giving you.
You will reap the harvest of that land.
You must bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם וּקְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ קְצִירָ֑הּ וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֶת־ עֹ֛מֶר רֵאשִׁ֥ית קְצִירְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD so that it may be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes the sheaf.
The priest waves the sheaf before the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The priest waves the sheaf so the LORD will accept you.
The priest does this on the day after the Sabbath.
passages.original: וְהֵנִ֧יף אֶת־ הָעֹ֛מֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם מִֽמָּחֳרַת֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת יְנִיפֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: On the day you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a year-old lamb without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD, along with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil—an offering made by fire to the LORD, a pleasing aroma—and its drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the Israelites.
God told the Israelites to bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of their harvest to the priest.
On the day the priest waves the sheaf before the LORD, you must bring an offering.
You must offer a lamb.
The lamb must be one year old.
The lamb must have no blemish.
You must offer the lamb as a burnt offering to the LORD.
You must also bring a grain offering.
The grain offering must be two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour.
You must mix the fine flour with oil.
You must burn this offering to the LORD.
This offering will have a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
You must also bring a drink offering.
The drink offering must be a quarter of a hin of wine.
passages.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֕ם בְּי֥וֹם הֲנִֽיפְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָעֹ֑מֶר כֶּ֣בֶשׂ תָּמִ֧ים בֶּן־ שְׁנָת֛וֹ לְעֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ וּמִנְחָתוֹ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים סֹ֣לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֛מֶן אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֑חַ וְנִסְכֹּ֥ה יַ֖יִן רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃

passages.text: You must not eat any bread or roasted or new grain until the very day you have brought this offering to your God. This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to His people Israel.
God said, “Do not eat bread before you bring the offering to God.”
Do not eat roasted grain before you bring the offering to God.
Do not eat new grain before you bring the offering to God.
You must wait until the very day you bring the offering to God.
This rule will never end.
This rule is for all your generations.
This rule is for you wherever you live.
passages.original: וְלֶחֶם֩ וְקָלִ֨י וְכַרְמֶ֜ל לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֗וּ עַד־ עֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה עַ֚ד הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־ קָרְבַּ֖ן אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, you are to count off seven full weeks.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a command.
God told them to count days.
They must start counting after the Sabbath.
They must begin on the day they bring the wave offering.
The wave offering is a sheaf of grain.
They must count seven weeks.
Each week must be complete.
They must count until seven full weeks have passed.
passages.original: וּסְפַרְתֶּ֤ם לָכֶם֙ מִמָּחֳרַ֣ת הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת מִיּוֹם֙ הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־ עֹ֖מֶר הַתְּנוּפָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שַׁבָּת֖וֹת תְּמִימֹ֥ת תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃

passages.text: You shall count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a command.
God told Israel to count days.
Start counting after the first Sabbath.
Count seven Sabbaths.
Count fifty days in total.
After fifty days, bring an offering.
Bring a new grain offering to the LORD.
passages.original: עַ֣ד מִֽמָּחֳרַ֤ת הַשַּׁבָּת֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ת תִּסְפְּר֖וּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֛ם מִנְחָ֥ה חֲדָשָׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Bring two loaves of bread from your dwellings as a wave offering, each made from two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as the firstfruits to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God told them to bring an offering to Him.
Each person must bring bread from their own home.
They must bring two loaves of bread.
Each loaf must be made from fine flour.
Each loaf must use two-tenths of an ephah of flour.
They must bake the bread with leaven.
They must present these loaves as a wave offering.
These loaves are the firstfruits to the LORD.
passages.original: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם תָּבִ֣יאּוּ׀ לֶ֣חֶם תְּנוּפָ֗ה שְׁ֚תַּיִם שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים סֹ֣לֶת תִּהְיֶ֔ינָה חָמֵ֖ץ תֵּאָפֶ֑ינָה בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Along with the bread you are to present seven unblemished male lambs a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the LORD, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions for a special offering.
You must bring bread as part of this offering.
With the bread, you must present seven male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each lamb must have no blemish.
You must also bring one young bull.
You must bring two rams.
You must offer all these animals to the LORD.
These animals are a burnt offering to the LORD.
You must also bring grain offerings with them.
You must bring drink offerings with them.
The fire will burn these offerings.
This offering will have a pleasing smell to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֣ם עַל־ הַלֶּ֗חֶם שִׁבְעַ֨ת כְּבָשִׂ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה וּפַ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד וְאֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם יִהְי֤וּ עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָתָם֙ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֔ם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: You shall also prepare one male goat as a sin offering and two male lambs a year old as a peace offering.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God told them to bring offerings to Him.
You must prepare one male goat.
This goat is for a sin offering.
You must also prepare two male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
These lambs are for a peace offering.
passages.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּ֑את וּשְׁנֵ֧י כְבָשִׂ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָ֖ה לְזֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִֽים׃

passages.text: The priest is to wave the lambs as a wave offering before the LORD, together with the bread of the firstfruits. The bread and the two lambs shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
passages.sermon:
The priest must take the two lambs.
The priest must take the bread of the firstfruits.
The priest must wave the lambs and the bread before the LORD.
This is a wave offering.
The bread and the two lambs are holy.
They belong to the LORD.
They are for the priest.
passages.original: וְהֵנִ֣יף הַכֹּהֵ֣ן׀ אֹתָ֡ם עַל֩ לֶ֨חֶם הַבִּכּוּרִ֤ים תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י כְּבָשִׂ֑ים קֹ֛דֶשׁ יִהְי֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly, and you must not do any regular work. This is to be a permanent statute wherever you live for the generations to come.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
On that same day, you must proclaim a sacred assembly.
You must not do any regular work.
This rule is a permanent statute.
You must keep it wherever you live.
You must keep it for all generations to come.
passages.original: וּקְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּעֶ֣צֶם׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם בְּכָל־ מוֹשְׁבֹ֥תֵיכֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap all the way to the edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and the foreign resident. I am the LORD your God.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God gave them a command about harvesting their land.
When you gather the harvest from your field, do not cut all the way to the edges.
Do not pick up the leftover stalks or grain from your harvest.
Leave the edges and the leftovers in the field.
Let the poor people take from them.
Let the foreigners who live among you take from them.
I am the LORD your God.
passages.original: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶ֞ם אֶת־ קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֗ם לֹֽא־ תְכַלֶּ֞ה פְּאַ֤ת שָֽׂדְךָ֙ בְּקֻצְרֶ֔ךָ וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִירְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: The LORD also said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest, a sacred assembly announced by trumpet blasts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a message for the Israelites.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD said, “On the first day of the seventh month, you must have a day of rest.
This day will be a sacred assembly.
You must announce this assembly with trumpet blasts.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן זִכְר֥וֹן תְּרוּעָ֖ה מִקְרָא־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: You must not do any regular work, but you are to present an offering made by fire to the LORD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God gave them a command.
You must not do any regular work.
You must present an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Again the LORD said to Moses, “The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. You shall hold a sacred assembly and humble yourselves, and present an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions for the Israelites.
The LORD said, “The tenth day of the seventh month is the Day of Atonement.
This day is a holy day for you.
You must gather for a sacred assembly.
You must humble yourselves.
You must present an offering made by fire to the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ אַ֡ךְ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ֩ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֨י הַזֶּ֜ה י֧וֹם הַכִּפֻּרִ֣ים ה֗וּא מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: On this day you are not to do any work, for it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
The Day of Atonement is a special day.
This day is called Yom Kippur.
On this day, God makes atonement for you.
God is the LORD your God.
You must not do any work on this day.
You stand before the LORD your God on this day.
God gives you atonement on this day.
passages.original: וְכָל־ מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י י֤וֹם כִּפֻּרִים֙ ה֔וּא לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: If anyone does not humble himself on this day, he must be cut off from his people.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave a command for the Day of Atonement.
The Day of Atonement is the tenth day of the seventh month.
God said every person must humble himself on this day.
If a person does not humble himself on this day, he will be cut off from his people.
passages.original: כִּ֤י כָל־ הַנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ תְעֻנֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃

passages.text: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on this day.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
God said this command through Moses.
God said, “This day is the Day of Atonement.”
Anyone who does any work on this day will be punished.
I, the LORD, will remove that person from his people.
No one may do any work on the Day of Atonement.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּ֛י אֶת־ הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: You are not to do any work at all. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
God said, “Do not do any work at all.
This rule will never end.
This rule is for all your descendants.
This rule applies wherever you live.”
passages.original: כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹֽשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: It will be a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall humble yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to keep your Sabbath.”
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to the Israelites.
This day will be a Sabbath for you.
This Sabbath is a day of complete rest.
You must humble yourselves on this day.
Begin this Sabbath at sunset on the ninth day of the month.
Keep the Sabbath from one evening until the next evening.
passages.original: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּתִשְׁעָ֤ה לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב מֵעֶ֣רֶב עַד־ עֶ֔רֶב תִּשְׁבְּת֖וּ שַׁבַּתְּכֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the Feast of Tabernacles to the LORD begins, and it continues for seven days.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a message.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD said, "On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, the Feast of Tabernacles begins."
This feast is for the LORD.
The Feast of Tabernacles lasts seven days.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֜ר י֗וֹם לַחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה חַ֧ג הַסֻּכּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים לַיהֹוָֽה׃

passages.text: On the first day there shall be a sacred assembly. You must not do any regular work.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God told them about the Feast of Tabernacles.
The Feast of Tabernacles begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month.
On the first day of this feast, the people must gather together.
This gathering is a sacred assembly.
On this day, the people must not do any regular work.
passages.original: בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: For seven days you are to present an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day you are to hold a sacred assembly and present an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave instructions for the Israelites.
The Israelites must present offerings to the LORD.
For seven days, the Israelites must bring offerings made by fire to the LORD.
On the eighth day, the Israelites must gather for a sacred assembly.
On the eighth day, the Israelites must present another offering made by fire to the LORD.
The eighth day is a solemn assembly.
The Israelites must not do any regular work on this day.
passages.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֡י מִקְרָא־ קֹדֶשׁ֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ עֲצֶ֣רֶת הִ֔וא כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for presenting offerings by fire to the LORD—burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each on its designated day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gives His people special feasts.
These feasts are called appointed times.
You must proclaim these feasts as sacred assemblies.
You must gather together for worship at these times.
You must present offerings by fire to the LORD at these feasts.
These offerings include burnt offerings.
These offerings include grain offerings.
These offerings include sacrifices.
These offerings include drink offerings.
You must bring each offering on its designated day.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ לְהַקְרִ֨יב אִשֶּׁ֜ה לַיהוָ֗ה עֹלָ֧ה וּמִנְחָ֛ה זֶ֥בַח וּנְסָכִ֖ים דְּבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: These offerings are in addition to the offerings for the LORD’s Sabbaths, and in addition to your gifts, to all your vow offerings, and to all the freewill offerings you give to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel special instructions about offerings.
God commanded certain offerings for His appointed feasts.
These offerings are not the only ones you must bring.
You must also bring offerings for the LORD’s Sabbaths.
You must also bring your gifts to the LORD.
You must also bring all your vow offerings to the LORD.
You must also bring all your freewill offerings to the LORD.
All these offerings are given to the LORD.
passages.original: מִלְּבַ֖ד שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת יְּהוָ֑ה וּמִלְּבַ֣ד מַתְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וּמִלְּבַ֤ד כָּל־ נִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וּמִלְּבַד֙ כָּל־ נִדְב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the produce of the land, you are to celebrate a feast to the LORD for seven days. There shall be complete rest on the first day and also on the eighth day.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel special instructions.
God commanded the people of Israel to keep certain feasts.
On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, you must celebrate a feast to the LORD.
You must do this after you gather the produce of the land.
You must celebrate this feast for seven days.
You must rest completely on the first day.
You must also rest completely on the eighth day.
passages.original: אַ֡ךְ בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י בְּאָסְפְּכֶם֙ אֶת־ תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֶת־ חַג־ יְהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּיּ֤וֹם הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י שַׁבָּתֽוֹן׃

passages.text: On the first day you are to gather the fruit of majestic trees, the branches of palm trees, and the boughs of leafy trees and of willows of the brook. And you are to rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
On the first day of the feast, you must gather certain plants.
You must take the fruit of beautiful trees.
You must take branches from palm trees.
You must take boughs from leafy trees.
You must take willows from the brook.
You must rejoice before the LORD your God.
You must rejoice for seven days.
passages.original: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן פְּרִ֨י עֵ֤ץ הָדָר֙ כַּפֹּ֣ת תְּמָרִ֔ים וַעֲנַ֥ף עֵץ־ עָבֹ֖ת וְעַרְבֵי־ נָ֑חַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: You are to celebrate this as a feast to the LORD for seven days each year. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come; you are to celebrate it in the seventh month.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to celebrate a feast to the LORD.
They must keep this feast for seven days each year.
This command is a permanent law for all their generations.
They must celebrate this feast in the seventh month.
passages.original: וְחַגֹּתֶ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ חַ֣ג לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You are to dwell in booths for seven days. All the native-born of Israel must dwell in booths, so that your descendants may know that I made the Israelites dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God commanded the Israelites to live in booths.
You must live in booths for seven days.
Every native-born person in Israel must live in booths.
You must do this so your descendants will know something important.
I, the LORD your God, made the Israelites live in booths.
I did this when I brought them out of the land of Egypt.
I am the LORD your God.
passages.original: בַּסֻּכֹּ֥ת תֵּשְׁב֖וּ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כָּל־ הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַּסֻּכֹּֽת׃ לְמַעַן֮ יֵדְע֣וּ דֹרֹֽתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י בַסֻּכּ֗וֹת הוֹשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּהוֹצִיאִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed feasts of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The LORD gave Moses instructions about special feasts.
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
Moses told the Israelites about the appointed feasts of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ מֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
